DrugComponent.title: DrugComponent
DrugComponent.description:
One active ingredient with its strength, in the shape of OMOP ``drug_strength``.

Use ``amount_*`` for solid forms (500 mg per tablet) and ``numerator_*``/``denominator_*``
for concentrations (100 mg per 5 mL, 1 %).

quantity_value.title: Quantity Value
quantity_value.description: Total volume or mass of one unit (ampoule 2 mL), not the pack size

DrugStructure.title: DrugStructure
DrugStructure.description:
A drug product broken into ingredients, strengths and dose form.

``quantity_*`` is the total volume or mass of one unit of the product (a 2 mL ampoule, a
0.4 mL prefilled syringe), as in the ``denominator_value`` of an OMOP Quant drug. A component's
``denominator_*`` only expresses its concentration (100 mg per 5 mL).
